notes.title: DelayedSun Early Access 1.3 Update & 75% OFF Discount
notes.content:
Heyya Folks![b]
DelayedSun is joining Steam Summer Sale 2023 with 75% off[/b] from today, until July 13, 10 am PDT | 7 pm CEST / July 14, 3 am AEST!

We brought back DelayedSun to development in order to fix bugs and bring more content into the game!
In this update, we fixed some bugs and focused more on little details in the game.

[b]DelayedSun Early Access 1.3 Update Changelogs:[/b]
- Updated some notes text with better English
- Fixed bugs zombies not spawning in Act A
- Fixed zombie AI got the stuck bug
- Balanced Deagle damage and fire rate
- Upgraded some sound effects and voice actor dialog
- Added foliages onto some spot

[b]What will you expect in the next update:[/b]
- We are working on an inventory system revamp with better readability by using a grid view instead of a simple scroll view. Moreover, the game will be slower when opening inventory.
- We are working on improving the character's animation by adding better locomotion, healing animation, etc.
- We are working on "Extras" mode (endless, minigames, etc)
- We are working on some fix to Elisa's movement and AI
- We are working on integrating Steam Achievement into the game
- We are working on better UI elements and animation

notes.title: Early Access 1.2 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay & Worlds[/h2]
1. The player can now perform a melee head attack combo when aimed at the zombie's head.
2. Improved melee responsiveness & bug fixes.
3. Fixed when the player pressed the objective details repeatedly the detail will show many times.
4. Fixed big house lighting intensity and flickering issue.
5. Some models are dirtier and specular intensity reduced.
6. Now the player can interact with the lever without interacting with the main bunker gate.
7. Now players can toggle control hints when driving a vehicle.
8. Improvement of main menu level environment.
9. Optimized camera movement and aiming socket.

[h2]Audio[/h2]
1. Elevator fall sound effect volume increased.
2. Reduced hard breath sound effect when player energy is low.
3. Improved some pickup sound effects.
4. Fixed SFX that doesn't affect by player volume settings.
5. Improved some of the dialog quality and volume.
6. Ladder fall explosion volume reduced.

[h2]User Interfaces[/h2]
1. Improved UI animation and UI consistency.
2. Improved item pickup notification gradient & animation.
3. Message box & subtitle UI font size reduced.
4. Fix flickering text when UI popped up.
5. UI Opacity & Timeout improved.

[h2]Misc[/h2]
1. Improved the use of English in various user interfaces and texts.
2. Fixed broken LOD and aggression.
3. Ambient occlusion intensity increased.
4. When the save game is deleted, the level will automatically restart.
5. Explosive Barrell draw distance tweaked.
6. Optimized LOD & Particle systems.
7. Performance Optimization & Bug Fixes.

DelayedSun Official Trailer https://youtu.be/Ctk60NQWLnE
In the future, we've planned that the game will be increased in overall quality, animation, UI, voice over, etc. Staytune for future update!

notes.title: Early Access 1.1 Update
notes.content:
DelayedSun Early Access 1.1 Update Changelog:

1. Pickup items highlight to make it easier to identify the items
2. Grenadier zombie tweaks
3. Now when the player press RMB and LMB at the same time, the melee attack won’t be triggered for the first 0.15s
4. Slowmotion effect cooldown duration increased
5. Messagebox UI improved
6. Zombie footstep & spawning sound volume increased
7. Now player can’t aim when a melee weapon is equipped
8. Skillpoint notification opacity reduced for a cleaner screen
9. Character Skills UI animation improved
10. Hard difficulty adjustment
11. Desert eagle fire rate increased
12. Sniper scope sensitivity reduced to match the default one.
13. Grenadier zombie dead delay fixed
14. Reduced green toxin hitbox & improved the material
15. Reduced Molotov fire hitbox
16. Player look at now have smoother animation & fixed player movement stopped when looking at objects.
17. Minor bug fixes
18. Improved overall performance and optimization
